name: RouteMux · chat-receipted
note: Predict → call once → reconcile. The request hash is the idempotency key, so the same drop can never bill twice; X-Request-ID and X-RouteMux-Billed come back in the receipt.

rows.label: request
rows.note: model, messages, optional predict{} block written by the operator or an upstream agent

rows.label: 1 predict
rows.value: bridge.mjs predict: sha256(request) → idempotency key; tokens ≈ chars/4; cost from the last pricing snapshot

rows.label: 2 call
rows.value: bridge.mjs chat: POST api.routemux.com/v1/chat/completions with Authorization + X-Idempotency-Key

rows.label: 3 report
rows.value: bridge.mjs report: usage, headers, latency vs the prediction

rows.label: report
rows.note: errors of each prediction, in percent

rows.label: extra
rows.value: status · model · request_id · billed · tokens · cost · latency
